description: Built 30 December 1980; registered 29 January 1981 as CCCP-65714 to the Latvian Civil Aviation Board at Riga-Skulte; transferred 31 December 1981 to the Azerbaijan Civil Aviation Directorate at Baku-Bina; to Azerbaijan Airlines (AZAL) in 1992 and re-registered 4K-65714 in 1993; named Sheki; withdrawn from 2009 and stored at Heydar Aliyev International Airport in Baku; in February 2014 the FUSELAGE ONLY was installed as a restaurant at Gelediz village in Quba District by Natik Bekmirzoyev; wings and empennage are not present
